fact: Law 133/V/2001 of 22 January 2001 (Articles 19-20) allows transfer of personal data abroad only to a country the CNPD finds adequately protective, with CNPD permission or authorisation on consent, contractual necessity or appropriate contractual clauses otherwise.
title: Data Protection Act – The Republic of Cape Verde, Law 133/V/2001 of 22 January
publisher: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD)
